frontmatter.name: commit-chai-n
frontmatter.description: Commit Chai-n, Queue-tea's git helper. Use for branch names, reading the state of a branch, splitting work into commits and writing their messages, drafting pull requests, and planning pushes, merges and pulls. It prepares every step and hands Rohan the commands that commit, push or merge; it never runs them.

frontmatter.name: chai-pter
frontmatter.description: Chai-pter, Queue-tea's documentation helper. Use to write or update a project's docs (README, spec, guides, changelogs, decision records, comments when asked) and to keep them true to the code, in plain writing that reads as a person wrote it. Use after a feature lands, or to find and fix docs that have drifted.

frontmatter.name: mocha-mockup
frontmatter.description: Mocha Mockup, Queue-tea's design helper. Use at the design stage of a task, before code: working out what to build, the options and their trade-offs, screens and their states, keys and flows, interfaces and data shapes, and the acceptance criteria. It returns a design to decide on, not production code.

frontmatter.name: tea-dd
frontmatter.description: Tea-DD, Queue-tea's testing helper. Use for every feature or fix to write its unit tests and, where they earn their place, integration and end-to-end tests, in the project's own test style, then run them and report the results. For a bug, it writes the failing test first.
